title: What the simulator establishes
tags: accuracy safe validated heat current numerical verification
text: VOLT-FORGE solves an electrical equivalent-circuit network coupled to one lumped temperature per cell. Simulation is conditional on the recorded parameters and boundary conditions. Energy balance checks solver consistency; it does not establish agreement with a real battery. Published-data assessment missed all 12 frozen voltage and temperature comparison cases. Never claim hardware safety or validated temperature accuracy.

title: Pi backup mission
tags: pi power watts load efficiency duration floor soc
text: The study scenario is 25 W for 600 s, 23 C ambient and 70% initial charge, with assumed 90% conversion and 3.3 V floor. 25 W is a supply-rating scenario, not measured Pi draw. The fixed 8.42 A proxy is P/(efficiency*floor voltage), not a dynamic constant-power model. The floor is a study requirement, not a manufacturer's cutoff.

title: Frozen design comparison
tags: two three four cell smallest cheaper cost mass weak redundancy
text: For same-end parallel outputs, frozen required-case results are 4 cells 51/51, worst 3.34 A and 26.1 C, 280 g and INR4824; 3 cells 42/42, 3.86 A and 27.7 C, 210 g and INR3618; 2 cells 33/33, 5.49 A and 31.8 C, 140 g and INR2412. These are historical study values, not the current selected experiment. Different case counts reflect positional variations. Two cells save half the cell cost and cell mass versus four, with less electrical margin. They have no spare. Fault tolerance requires assessing the actual fault topology and protection.

title: Why parallel cells carry different currents
tags: busiest uneven resistance wiring series parallel current cell
text: Cells share current according to their open-circuit voltage, resistance, polarization and the wiring paths. A short path to the output can carry more current initially; it need not remain the busiest throughout a discharge. The same-end layout can be less even than opposite-end outputs, but no wiring option wins every mismatch case. Series cells carry the same branch current; series raises voltage, parallel raises capacity.

title: Temperature estimates and cooling
tags: temperature heat thermal cooling ambient hot
text: Temperature is one lumped state per cell, not a spatial surface or core-temperature prediction. It depends on heat generation, heat capacity, declared cooling and cell contacts. Ambient temperature is distinct from the cell model's characterized temperature range. Changing the drawing alone does not change thermal contact. A new assembly's cooling is not established by the source rig.

title: Limits and incomplete qualification
tags: limits refuse unsupported qualifies incomplete custom charging circulation
text: Keep application targets, model coverage, component operating limits and physical protection separate. Missing applicable cell limits make sizing incomplete rather than evidence of safety. Evaluate each cell's actual current direction: one branch can charge while the module discharges. Charge-domain and temperature-domain stops indicate model coverage boundaries.

title: LG M50T operating conditions
tags: lg m50t current 7.275 temperature charge discharge cold
text: The LG sheet gives discharge current 2.425 A at -20 to 10 C, 14.55 A at 10 to 25 C, and 7.275 A at 25 to 55 C. The deployed model conservatively uses 7.275 A above 10 C. Charging is 1.455 A up to 25 C and 3.395 A up to 45 C; use the live catalogue for model coverage and actual limits. Do not substitute M50LT parameters for M50T.

title: Candidate UPS boards
tags: board converter x1205 x1206 compatible efficiency protection
text: X1205 is a two-slot 21700 Pi UPS board; X1206 is four-slot. Listing fit does not verify hardware compatibility. Battery-current limits and actual backup efficiency remain unverified. The cited up-to-95% source concerns the external-input step-down path, not battery-to-Pi efficiency. A fixed board layout does not implement arbitrary output routing. Prices are historical listings, not current stock guarantees.

title: Interpreting charge and energy
tags: charging ah wh capacity received delivered net series
text: Terminal Ah is the integral of pack current. Series count does not multiply pack-terminal Ah. Gross received and delivered Ah are separate; net gained Ah is received minus delivered. Per-cell Ah is separate. Wh integrates terminal power. A constant-current charge interval is not a complete CC-CV recharge-time forecast.

title: Ideal and dimensioned links
tags: wire connection resistance copper loss density zero
text: Dimensioned links carry material, length, area, resistance and mass assumptions. Replacing them with direct resistance removes the physical definition. Ideal zero-resistance links are contracted by the solver; their individual current may be uncomputed, not zero. Zero resistive loss is separate from current. A/mm2 is not a certified rating.

title: Comparing saved experiments
tags: compare old stale historical results model software fair
text: Compare like loads, duration, preparation, models, cooling and requirements. A saved run is immutable evidence under its own software and model versions. The editable design can differ from the historical result. Explain selected test results from their own saved model cards and samples. State differences before interpreting performance deltas.

title: Editing and preserving browser work
tags: save backup import download recover draft blank reload browser
text: Browser work is temporary. Download an editable JSON design backup before closing or refreshing; import creates a new design. Exported result ZIPs are report and replay packages, not complete project imports. Blank mandatory numeric fields are unapplied drafts; deliberate zero must be typed. Review or discard pending drafts before save/run. Proposed AI edits require the application's preview and approval.

title: Bounded sizing and investigations
tags: smallest optimize optimisation pressure search break
text: Find the smallest design rebuilds simple parallel arrangements and tests nominal conditions for the saved load. The separate frozen study adds cell mismatch and sensitivities. A finite search does not establish a global optimum or universal safe envelope. Preserve refused, failed, unsupported and incomplete distinctions.

title: Commercial hypothesis
tags: price licence business cost student lab team
text: Student use is proposed free, lab licences INR50000 per year and team licences INR500000 per year up to five seats. These prices and adoption assumptions are untested. Full product build estimate is INR35.38 crore over three years, not the cost of the current prototype. Market enrolments are audience counts, not paying customers.
